name: plannotator
description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
one_liner: A shared inbox where a team can watch everything their AI coding agents are doing, leave comments on the agent's plans and code, and send feedback back with one click.
buyer: An engineering lead running multiple AI coding agents across a team who needs one place to review and steer all of them instead of chasing output across scattered tools.
business_use_cases: A dev team wires every agent's plan and diff into it so a senior engineer can approve or redirect work before it merges, instead of reviewing scattered Slack messages.
An agency running client work through AI agents uses it as the client-facing review surface, so clients approve features without wading through raw code.
A solo founder running several agents in parallel uses it as a single dashboard to stay 'in the loop' without babysitting each terminal.

money_ideas.idea: Sell team and org tiers with multi-seat review, audit trail, and permissions
Offer an enterprise on-prem deployment with SSO for companies that can't send agent output to a third-party cloud

steal_this: Add a Slack or email digest of pending agent plans awaiting review and sell it as a lightweight add-on to teams already using it — a thin wrapper buildable in a weekend.
